label: preparing
what: A surprise tribute celebrating my forty years as mayor, in the great hall on day 1 at 18:00, disguised as a lighting inspection. Innkeeper arranges catering, Freight delivers bread, and Builder handles lighting. Secretary knowingly maintains the appointment and has disclosed the surprise to me; Watchman knows of approved hospitality arrangements, although his knowledge of the tribute itself is unconfirmed. Preparations were initially concealed from me but are now known through Secretary's report.
